ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR38] Requires Multi_Country__c (picklist) per IRM correction. Field created in IRMNewDev. Stage updated 2026-09-24: gate evaluates the next stage per IRM.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISPICKVAL(Multi_Country__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Multi-Country is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
